concerns.text: The plan defines the bias metric Δₖ = E_quant,ₖ − E_inst,ₖ and uses the condition median(Δₖ) > 0.10 × median(E_inst,ₖ) to declare quantization dominance. This assumes that the quantization‑induced error adds linearly to the instrumental‑only error (i.e., that MSE is additive), which is not guaranteed for Bayesian parameter‑estimation pipelines where noise and quantization can interact non‑linearly. Consequently, the validation target (Δₖ) is not an independent measure of quantization impact but a derived quantity that may mis‑represent the true systematic bias, making the “10 % rule” potentially tautological.
